verdict: gates unmet: B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B9, B10

gates.requirement: All P0 requirements have automated evidence or a documented acceptance review
gates.evidence: 28 acceptance criteria mapped to suites in release/exit_gate.py AC_MAP; suite runs in release/raw/

gates.requirement: All 24 scenario templates trigger in reference fixtures; valid trigger coverage exceeds 95% of eligible scheduled cases, the remainder explained
gates.evidence: library holds 24 templates; the execution suite executes each through the fixture runner and asserts trigger plus nontrigger evidence per pair
gaps: fixture scope only: no scheduled campaign has run, so coverage over eligible scheduled cases is unmeasured

gates.requirement: No known unsupported external path is represented as mediated
gates.evidence: adapter manifests must enumerate unsupported families, and capabilities plus unsupported paths must cover all nine fault families; the conformance suite rejects a silent family and a lying capability
gaps: contract scope only: no deployed mediation surface exists to audit, so the product-wide claim is untested

gates.requirement: No successful hard-boundary bypass in a predeclared 10,000-case conformance/adversarial suite, plus independent review
gates.evidence: the automated half: TestExitGateAdversarialSweep runs 10,000 seeded cases (7,100 violations across 11 boundary categories, 2,900 controls) with zero allows on violations, plus the integration boundary tests
gaps: no independent review has been performed

gates.requirement: On a held-out benign cohort of at least 1,000 sessions, the reference control profile's one-sided 95% upper bound for material false intervention is below 1%
gaps: no benign cohort exists: the bound calculator and its property tests exist in control-plane, but no sessions have run
requires a documented cohort with dependence assumptions before the number means anything

gates.requirement: Authorized task completion is no more than three percentage points below the hard-controls-only baseline on the specified solvable cohort, with paired uncertainty
gaps: no solvable cohort and no paired baseline runs exist
paired-uncertainty reporting is specified but unexercised

gates.requirement: All outage and dirty-cleanup cases fail safely under the stated supported model
gates.evidence: predeclared case list in release/exit_gate.py REQUIRED_CASES; sink failures, reviewer outages, capture failures, lease loss, expired grants, and dirty cleanup each hold or fence
gaps: the hardened ephemeral execution backend is not implemented in this repository, so fail-safe behavior is verified on the local fixture model only

gates.requirement: Every serious finding has raw evidence and an independent outcome reference
gates.evidence: the plumbing is tested: portable reports must name their evidence chain and artifacts by digest, and outcome assertions come from outside the acting monitor
gaps: no beta campaign has run, so no serious findings exist to audit; the gate cannot be met without real operations

gates.requirement: Latency, cost, privacy, and operator-control targets have actual benchmark reports
gates.evidence: benchmarks/report.json covers the measurable targets in-process with conditions and raw output
gaps: areas without an honest number: ['Monitoring inference cost', 'Hosted service availability', 'Real workflow integration']
cost, privacy, and operator control have no benchmark surface yet; deployment-scale reports do not exist

gates.requirement: At least three design partners integrated, two intend to pay under a pilot agreement, and naming clearance is complete
gaps: no design partners have integrated a workflow
the AgentChaos name conflict (spec 23.3) is unresolved
